description: The third act, half a sheet

participation.context: Began the third act and wrote half a sheet.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: With the second act done, you put a new head on a sheet and brought the king home to Wales. Half the sheet was written by the time you stopped. The coffer stayed shut.

title: Began the third act

relations.note: a king, and a length, and no term agreed
relations.quote: Tell him I've a king coming.

story.body: You set down that a king is coming and that it is long. Nothing is agreed. You did not price the timber, and you did not write home.

relations.note: a king, and a length, and no term agreed
relations.quote: Tell him I've a king coming.

title: Wrote that a king is coming and that it is long
